probes.method: precise reading of the actual guest bootstrap and HTTP response

anchors.text: return { matchId: data.matchId, roomCode, status: data.status };

probes.result: The guest lacks campaignId before its registered direct creator, and the existing invite response cannot supply it. Current full metadata GET requires host/seated membership but still returns raw state. An authenticated narrow response is necessary for the selected privacy-preserving all-creators-bound implementation. Privacy basis corrected under F3: this avoids returning raw match metadata, but does not make campaignId secret. The additional disclosure is the code/match-to-campaign correlation; self-issued bearers do not establish membership, and pre-existing unauthenticated campaign REST exposure is Root backlog B15.
probes.minimalRepair: Add explicit authenticated campaignIdentity=1 mode to the existing invite handler; return only identity plus the existing summary, using the existing verifier and server-derived campaign-session scope. Preserve anonymous shape, expire invalid codes, no-store, no seat mutation or authority grant.
probes.alternative: A separate endpoint would also need a new route/test grant. Unbound bootstrap requires an incompatible behavior interpretation and no prebind credit. Neither is claimed impossible; the selected minimum reuses the existing resolver.

probes.method: precise reading of the real existing invite-response test
probes.result: The real invite response requires a server-side authentication/disclosure test beyond UI mocks. The initial multiplayerMatchMeta.test.ts proposal overlaps completed U35c/U35d/U35e ownership. Root explicitly permits a non-colliding exact replacement. Existing securityBoundary.test.ts is an API security suite with no unit owner overlap; its current auth/store defaults are mocks, so a new isolated fixture must delegate authenticateRequest to jest.requireActual and room-code reads to a real InMemoryMatchStore. The old metadata suite stays unchanged as a regression control.
probes.minimalRepair: Add an isolated invite-identity describe block using the actual invite handler, generated signed tokens, actual verifier, and real InMemoryMatchStore behind the existing mock store boundary. Restore previous mock behavior between describes. Assert exact private-field-free response, anonymous legacy shape, all auth/scope/query/status failures, no-store and no seat/receipt mutation. No mockResolvedValue(ok:true) as authentication proof; no imported unowned test helper. F4: make the hoisted auth wrapper and fixed store factory swappable; the baseline store object lacks getMatchByRoomCode. Restore original delegates after the new signed-token cases.
probes.alternative: A new prospective test would fail current ownership-path existence validation in a docs-only amendment. The existing unowned API security suite fits both the test responsibility and the unchanged validator without creating a placeholder file.

probes.method: precise reading of registry mutations and captured subscription lifetime
probes.result: onFrame attaches only to the captured object; the getter has no invalidation subscription and consumer rejoin state is private to the surface. No delivered API synchronously informs the launch/entry subscription when the registry replaces A with B.
probes.minimalRepair: Add subscribeActiveCampaignSyncTransport(matchId,onChange) at the registry owner. Notify after every actual identity mutation; guarded removal of A cannot remove B. Callers subscribe then reconcile via getter, detach before attach, guard each use, and dispose listeners without closing foreign/shared B.
probes.alternative: Polling or duplicating registry notifications in page owners can miss the first B frame or non-page register/close paths. This design chooses the authoritative registry seam; it does not claim a missing compiler field or modify F.

probes.method: precise reading of existing real socket fixture and cleanup tests
probes.result: Page mocks alone do not prove all real registry mutation paths, disposal, late close identity guards, observer exceptions/reentrancy or wire compatibility. The existing transport suite owns the real socket/reset fixture.
probes.minimalRepair: Add replacement/registration/removal/reset/exception/reentrancy tests here; add real A-to-B page behavior in the already registered entry/launch suites and retain raw legacy-wire controls.
probes.alternative: A new dedicated observer suite is possible but needs the same extra literal test grant; no standalone helper is necessary.

privacyBaseline.bearer: Tokens are self-signed Ed25519: any vault identity can mint one. Verification binds playerId to the supplied public key and signature, without an admitted-principal registry. The invite gate is vault identity plus live room-code possession; the room code is the actual secret, not bearer membership.
privacyBaseline.existingDisclosure: GET /api/campaigns anonymously enumerates campaign IDs. GET/PUT/DELETE /api/campaigns/[id] lack caller authentication. CampaignId is a de-facto capability for these pre-existing REST routes, subject to existing record-authority, payload, version and live-host guards; it is not globally secret.
privacyBaseline.newDisclosure: The genuinely new disclosure is roomCode/matchId -> campaignId correlation to live-code holders who are not yet admitted, including full-seat, revoked or never-joining callers. The identity response does not establish confidentiality or authorization for the separate REST routes.
privacyBaseline.authority: WS membership, revocation and seat checks remain the actual co-op authority. A returned correlation cannot grant a WS seat, WS stream or application-receipt authority; expectedCampaignId remains a consistency binding.

backlog.status: Root records the pre-existing unauthenticated campaign-record REST exposure separately; outside G2 and not fixed or closed by this amendment.

privacyBaseline.method: Precise reading of the full auth verifier and campaign route handlers, not a runtime authorization test or a G2 remediation claim.

admissionRisks.requiredWork: Delegate auth to jest.requireActual, room-code lookup to a real InMemoryMatchStore, add an in-file Ed25519 token fixture, and restore defaults between cases. Keep existing tests truthful and do not count success-only auth mocks as proof.
admissionRisks.capImpact: Test additions are line-exempt, but any extracted fixture helper adds a file to the zero-spare manifest and requires the ordinary-cap split.

admissionRisks.risk: Aggregate added-line cap fit does not establish modularity fit; contingency likelihood is higher than the census alone suggests.
admissionRisks.rule: FILE_MODULARITY_SPEC split triggers include runtime >500 and practical extraction when growth exceeds about 40 lines above soft max. Warning-only lint does not waive these guardrails.
admissionRisks.requiredAction: Recheck actual verified predecessor sizes at admission. With 15/15 files and zero spare, any required extraction forces a separately registered ordinary-cap contingency split with the helper counted and estimates remeasured. Do not silently add a helper or waive modularity/proof.
